nodes.label: Mod scaffold
nodes.rationale: Correct layer registration and consistent mod paths prevent silent script loading failures.

nodes.label: Dedicated server testing
nodes.rationale: Separate server and client processes reveal RPC authority, timing and missing-identity issues that a listen server can hide.

nodes.label: biprivatekey
nodes.rationale: Keep the private signing key out of the public release and retain the same key for compatible updates.

nodes.label: Timer accumulator
nodes.rationale: Periodic HUD refresh avoids sending server-info requests on every frame.

nodes.label: MyModManager
nodes.rationale: A singleton centralizes mission state; initialization guards and shutdown cleanup prevent duplicate active managers.

nodes.label: MyModConfig
nodes.rationale: Public defaults remain useful when older configuration files omit newly introduced fields.

nodes.label: MFM_RallyHatchback
nodes.rationale: Extending a vanilla vehicle preserves its model rig, animations and underlying simulation while customizing behavior and appearance.

nodes.label: MCM_TacticalJacket_ColorBase
nodes.rationale: A hidden common base shares clothing properties while public concrete variants select textures.

nodes.label: heatIsolation
nodes.rationale: Actual warmth also depends on clothing condition and wetness, beyond the base insulation value.

nodes.label: ShopItem
nodes.rationale: Keeping the sell price below the buy price prevents a profitable buy-sell loop.

nodes.label: ShopDemoRPC
nodes.rationale: The tutorial delimiter format is fragile when labels contain delimiters; structured serialization is recommended for production.

nodes.label: Server-side validation
nodes.rationale: The client supplies item class and quantity; server catalog prices and inventory determine whether a trade can proceed.

nodes.label: Script profiler
nodes.rationale: Profiling adds overhead; disable it for baseline FPS measurements. Native proto work is attributed to the calling script function.

nodes.label: CEApi
nodes.rationale: Most CE debug tools require single-player with CE enabled; the chapter identifies Building Stats as the multiplayer exception.
